subject: Controlled-technology review: NewWave pilot commercial + compliance hold
messages:

Date: Thu, 1 Mar 2028 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot request + commercial terms (NewWave)

Hi Michael,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the latency numbers looked promising. We're keen to run a 3-month pilot (dedicated capacity) for our perception stack and would like to discuss pricing and deployment model. Two asks from our side: a 25% pilot discount and the option to run Redwood Private in our EU VPC for IP/data isolation.

A heads-up on product scope: our sensor firmware and inference are dual-use; some models are used in commercial robotics but could be adapted for industrial inspection with sensitive end-users. Happy to share more in a short call.

I've attached our company registration and a redacted product spec to speed KYC. Let me know next steps and any compliance information you need.

Best,
Sam

Head of Platform
NewWave Robotics

From: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Mar 2028 08:17:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Pilot request + commercial terms (NewWave) — trade/compliance escalation

Team — forwarding; flagging for Deal Desk + Compliance review. Summary: NewWave (NewWave Robotics GmbH, registered in Lumeria) requests 3-month dedicated pilot + 25% pilot discount and a Private deployment in their EU VPC. Customer provided company certificate and a redacted product spec that indicates sensors with potential dual-use (long-range imaging + calibration modules).

Known risk vectors:
- Lumeria has recent import restrictions on certain long-range imaging sensors (per export control watch).
- Product spec references hardware that could be subject to controlled-technology rules.
- Customer requests a Private deployment and key custody in their VPC (we need to validate KMS/HSM controls).

Proposed mitigations:
1) Denied parties/PEP screening and standard KYC (we need to confirm ultimate beneficial owners).
2) Technical guardrails: model-level telemetry only, no model weights export, disable any feature that would enable remote firmware flashing.
3) Contractual: limited-use clause for controlled outputs, increased audit rights, and escrow/attestation for KMS.
4) Commercial: pilot discount capped at 20% if compliance signs off and legal accepts the limited-use clause.

Ask: Priyom, can you run pricing scenario for 20% vs 25%? Evelyn/Neha, please confirm feasibility from export/control and KYC standpoint — if you need more customer docs, say so. Ben, this may need VP sign-off for concession beyond standard pilot thresholds.

-Michael
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Mar 2028 15:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pilot request + commercial terms (NewWave) — trade/compliance escalation

Quick assessment from Legal/Compliance:

We need the following before moving forward:
- Completed Export Control Questionnaire (I'll send template)
- Denied/Restricted party checks on entity and UBOs (I ran an initial screening; name variants match a party with ties to a sanctioned supplier — need confirmation)
- Clarify whether any software will be delivered outside EU or if telemetry will include geolocated imagery.

If the above returns clean, I can sign off on a limited pilot with strict contract language. If not clean, we must decline. Given potential ties to a sanctioned supplier, this looks higher risk than typical pilot.

Next steps: Michael to ask customer to fill questionnaire and provide UBO details; Neha to perform the denied-party screening and produce a short risk memo. If results are acceptable, this will require commercial approval from Ben (VP Sales) for 20% pilot concession and approval to allow Private deployment.

—Evelyn
General Counsel (acting) | Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 4 Mar 2028 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pilot request + commercial terms (NewWave) — trade/compliance escalation

Thanks team — read. I appreciate the cautious framing. Given the strategic potential of NewWave (robotics OEM with strong channel upside) and if Compliance clears the denied-party check and Legal finalizes the limited-use language, I'm prepared to approve a conditional pilot concession:

- Commercial: 20% pilot discount (maximum), 3-month duration, non-renewable without separate approval.
- Deployment: Private in customer EU VPC only; Redwood-managed KMS with customer read-access is acceptable if Legal signs off on escrow language. No model artifact export.
- Compliance gating: Pilot may not commence until Neha confirms denied-party screening is clean and Evelyn signs the compliance addendum.
- Operational: Add a weekly checkpoint to the mutual action plan and an automated telemetry filter to remove geolocation in telemetry sent to Redwood.

Priyom — please reflect the 20% cap in the Deal Desk record (HS-987654) and prepare a short commercial memo for exec review if anything deviates. Michael — hold the MSA until we have Legal/Compliance sign-off.

Ben
VP Sales | Redwood Inference
